question:
Select the option that is related to the third number-pair in the same way as the second number-pair is related to the first number-pair and the sixth number-pair is related to the fifth number-pair.

[13/17] ∶ [17/13] ∶∶ [23/18] ∶ ? ∶∶ [33/26] ∶ [26/33]
solution:
The logic followed here is:

Logic: **Numbers are written in reverse order**.

Now,

For, [13/17] ∶ [17/13]

⇒ [13/17] reverse [17/13]

For, [33/26] ∶ [26/33]</sp
